messages:
deploybot: Deploy started for staging cluster 'staging-east' — release=v3.4.0-rc7 commit=9f4c2a tag=release/v3.4.0-rc7 changewindow=now :rocket:
alice: Copy that, kicking off smoke suite now. I'll post failures as they happen.
bob: Heads-up: we're seeing a heavier-than-usual traffic replay for reranker tests — may surface flakiness.
deploybot: Smoke summary (initial): 
```
service: reranker   2/6 instances 502
service: api        6/6 instances 200
service: ingester   5/5 instances 200
```
caroline: Hmm. Reranker 502s look like a model loading OOM during startup. Last known good tag for reranker is release/reranker-2.1.3 (commit a7c3d1). Suggest pinning reranker and let the rest roll.
bob: +1 from me. Pin reranker to release/reranker-2.1.3 and continue. We can follow up with a repro in eng-ml.
deploybot: Initiating pin for service=reranker -> target=release/reranker-2.1.3 (a7c3d1). Rolling update scope=single-service expected downtime ~30s :hourglass_flowing_sand:
dave: Running watch on pod readiness and error-rate. If crashloop persists beyond 90s, we'll open a rollback.
sre-bot: Alert: reranker pod reranker-7f9b crashed 3x within 60s — automated restart attempted.
caroline: Pin applied. Reranker pods have come up on 2/2 with previous image, no 502s now. Logs show model loaded successfully.
alice: Re-running smoke. Core API smoke green. Reranker smoke now passing on replay. :white_check_mark:
bob: Nice. Given model load flakiness, I recommend we do NOT promote this reranker build to prod until eng-ml investigates. Keep the pin in staging and record the failure in the release notes.
deploybot: Staging deploy status: non-reranker services: COMPLETED at 2951234588. reranker: PINNED to release/reranker-2.1.3 (a7c3d1). Overall staging rollout: PARTIAL-COMPLETE.
caroline: I'll add an item to the release notes and tag eng-ml. Link: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/v3.4.0-rc7 (note: reranker pinned due to startup OOM on new image).
dave: Monitoring: 5m error rate back to baseline, 95th latency ok. Recommend we close the staging changewindow but hold any prod canary for 24h.
alice: Agreed. Closing staging changewindow now. Leaving prod-promote hold flag=true. :lock:
bob: Thanks everyone — nice quick pin. I'll follow up with a brief runbook for eng-ml to repro the OOM.
deploybot: Thread closed for deploybot notification: artifacts uploaded -> s3://redwood-releases/v3.4.0-rc7/artifacts.tar.gz. If you need to re-run the deploy: `./deploy --env=staging --tag=release/v3.4.0-rc7`
(reacts: alice :white_check_mark:, caroline :thumbsup:, bob :thumbsup:)
